description: This file provides a utility to map Unicode Latin characters to ASCII equivalents and a function to replace non-ASCII characters in a string with their mapped ASCII counterparts, effectively 'latinising' the input.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Maps a single Unicode Latin character to its ASCII equivalent using the latinMap dictionary.

methods.name: latinise
methods.description: Replaces all non-ASCII Latin characters in the input string with their ASCII equivalents by using the map function.
